checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: fix the Lighthouse target-size finding on dossier gallery dots, add a target-size check to the local a11y audit, align upstream live-app sources, verify print output, then re-run Lighthouse and all gates. Evidence: project.html?repo=Noesis scored accessibility 0.96 with 6 target-size failures on .gallery-dot buttons; best-practices and SEO were 1.00.

impact_assessment.why: The last measured defect left on the site is the dossier gallery's small touch targets; the DOM audit does not check hit-area size, upstream sources still carry unlabeled controls, and the print rule has only been tested statically.
impact_assessment.benefits: Dossier accessibility reaches 1.00; the audit catches target-size regressions; upstream and site-side labelling converge; print output is verified rather than assumed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: gallery dot markup and tests are pinned; dependency: upstream repos are not checked out locally; concurrency: other sessions edit rust/ and reports/; state: Lighthouse needs a focused visible browser tab
impact_assessment.mitigation: Write a failing-first CSS/audit assertion, keep the sync-tool patch until upstream is fixed, use headless Chromium print-to-PDF if available, and re-run Lighthouse plus 6/6 gates before commit.

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Verified assumptions: .gallery-dot is 8x8 px (Lighthouse target-size cause); audit lacks target-size checks; upstream checkouts absent so sync patch stays; Edge binary available for print-to-PDF. Implementing gallery dot hit-area fix with failing-first test.

[4/4] Complete: gallery and live dots enlarged to 26px hit areas; audit now checks target-size with 0 findings; sync tool label coverage test added; print PDF verified archived cards appear (18 to 29 pages); Lighthouse on dossier now 1.00/1.00/1.00 with 0 failures; 209 tests OK.
Task 'dossier-a11y-polish' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: (1) stop the AIKit dossier from offering dead GitHub links since its repo is private; (2) generate sitemap entries for all dossier pages and test coverage; (3) replace the stale no-JS 'Showing all 48' status copy. Evidence: gh reports AIKit private=true while project.js sets both repo and README links unconditionally; sitemap.xml has 7 URLs and zero project.html URLs; index.html fallback says 48 while the catalogue has 74.

impact_assessment.why: These are three concrete visitor-facing gaps found in the latest review; each is small and independently testable.
impact_assessment.benefits: No dead links, dossiers become indexable, and no-JS copy is honest.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sitemap static URLs and filter-status copy are pinned by tests; dependency: private-repo list is presentation policy; concurrency: none active; state: generated sitemap must stay in sync with catalogue
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add failing-first tests for each, keep the private list explicit and documented, generate sitemap from repositories.json with a coverage test, then run all gates and browser checks.
